content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 3

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 3:1 | He-shall-not-be-reckoned-righteous who-walks | He shall not be reckoned among the righteous who walks | No one who stubbornly follows his own heart can be counted among the righteous | structural | SOPHIA: "He shall not be reckoned among the righteous who walks" — follows LOGOS; PNEUMA restructures too freely |
| 2 | 3:2 | In-the-spring-of the-perfect he-shall-not-be-counted | At the spring of the perfect ones he shall not be numbered | Among the truly faithful he will never be included | word choice | SOPHIA: "Among the truly perfect he shall not be numbered" — "perfect" closer to Hebrew tamim than PNEUMA's "faithful" |
| 3 | 3:3 | Unclean, unclean | Unclean, unclean | He remains utterly defiled | word choice | SOPHIA: "Unclean, unclean" — EMET/LOGOS preserve the emphatic Hebrew doubling; PNEUMA paraphrases away the repetition |
| 4 | 3:4 | not-being-instructed in-the-community-of His-counsel | refusing instruction in the community of His counsel | rejecting the discipline found within God's purposeful community | word choice | SOPHIA: "refusing instruction in the community of His counsel" — LOGOS preferred; PNEUMA's "discipline" shifts nuance |
| 5 | 3:5 | are-the-ways-of a-man atoned | are the ways of a man atoned | a person's way of life is set right | word choice | SOPHIA: "are the ways of a man set right" — compromise; "atoned" too narrow, PNEUMA's "set right" captures broader sense |
| 6 | 3:6 | spirit-of holiness of-the-community | holy spirit of the community | holy spirit active in the community | structural | SOPHIA: "holy spirit of the community" — follows LOGOS; PNEUMA adds "active" interpretively |
| 7 | 3:8 | submission-of his-soul | submission of his soul | willing submission of their whole self | word choice | SOPHIA: "submission of his soul" — EMET/LOGOS agree; PNEUMA adds "willing" and changes "soul" to "whole self" |
| 8 | 3:9 | to-sanctify-himself with-the-waters-of-cleanness | sanctified by the waters of cleanness | made holy by cleansing streams | word choice | SOPHIA: "sanctified by the waters of cleanness" — LOGOS; PNEUMA's "streams" departs from Hebrew niddah |
| 9 | 3:10 | in-perfection | in perfection | with complete devotion | word choice | SOPHIA: "in perfection" — EMET/LOGOS agree on tamim; PNEUMA interprets too freely |
| 10 | 3:14 | Sons-of-Light | Sons of Light | Children of Light | word choice | SOPHIA: "Sons of Light" — consistent with Cols. 1-2 decisions |
| 11 | 3:14-15 | concerning-the-nature of-all the-sons-of-man | concerning the nature of all the children of man | about the true character of every human being | structural | SOPHIA: "concerning the true nature of all the children of man" — blends LOGOS structure with PNEUMA's "true" |
| 12 | 3:15 | with-their-signs | with their distinguishing signs | with their identifying traits | word choice | SOPHIA: "with their distinguishing signs" — LOGOS preferred; PNEUMA's "traits" loses the Hebrew 'otot |
| 13 | 3:16 | visitation-of their-afflictions | visitation of their afflictions | consequences they face: both their sufferings | structural | SOPHIA: "visitation of their afflictions" — EMET/LOGOS preserve pequddah; PNEUMA over-paraphrases |
| 14 | 3:17 | From-the-God-of knowledge is all that-is and-that-shall-be | From the God of knowledge comes all that is and all that shall be | Everything that exists or ever will exist comes from the God of all knowledge | structural | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS word order — closer to Hebrew; PNEUMA inverts the sentence |
| 15 | 3:19 | nothing is-to-be-changed | nothing is to be changed | nothing can be altered | word choice | SOPHIA: "nothing can be changed" — slight modification; all three essentially agree |
| 16 | 3:19 | ordinances-of all | laws governing all things | governing principles of all things | word choice | SOPHIA: "governing principles of all things" — compromise between EMET's brevity and PNEUMA's clarity |
| 17 | 3:20 | for-the-dominion-of the-world | to have dominion over the world | to govern the world | word choice | SOPHIA: "to have dominion over the world" — LOGOS preserves memshelet; PNEUMA simplifies |
| 18 | 3:22-23 | In-a-spring-of-light...from-a-well-of darkness | From a spring of light...from a well of darkness | From a fountain of light...from a wellspring of darkness | word choice | SOPHIA: "From a spring of light...from a well of darkness" — LOGOS preferred; PNEUMA's "fountain/wellspring" embellishes |
| 19 | 3:23 | Prince-of-Lights | Prince of Lights | Prince of Light | word choice | SOPHIA: "Prince of Lights" — EMET/LOGOS preserve Hebrew plural me'orot; PNEUMA drops plural |
| 20 | 3:26 | straying-of all the-sons-of-righteousness | all the sons of righteousness go astray | even the righteous go astray | structural | SOPHIA: "all the sons of righteousness go astray" — LOGOS; PNEUMA loses technical "sons of" designation |
